info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: Event management API for South African road running, walking and cycling events. Log in via POST /api/auth/login first; Swagger then sends the session cookie automatically.

post.summary: Registers a new Organiser or Participant account.
post.description: Participants must also supply DateOfBirth and Gender. The password is hashed before it is stored.

post.summary: Logs in and starts a session that remembers the user's id and role.

200.description: Logged in. A session cookie is returned.

post.summary: Logs out by clearing the session.

get.summary: Lists the categories of an event. Public.

post.summary: Creates an age or distance category for an event. Event owner only.

400.description: Validation failed (e.g. MinAge greater than MaxAge).

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of the event.

409.description: A category with that name already exists for this event.

put.summary: Updates a category. Event owner only.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of the event.

delete.summary: Deletes a category. Event owner only; not allowed while participants are enrolled in it.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of the event.

409.description: Participants are still enrolled in this category.

post.summary: Enters the logged-in Participant into an event by choosing a category.
post.description: Records the link between Participant, Event and Category and assigns a bib number.

404.description: Event, or that category within the event, not found.

get.summary: Lists everyone enrolled in an event. Only the Organiser who owns the event.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

get.summary: Lists the logged-in Participant's own enrolments.

put.summary: Sets an enrolment's status to Pending, Confirmed or Cancelled. Event owner only.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

delete.summary: Withdraws the logged-in Participant from an event (deletes their own enrolment).

403.description: Not a Participant, or not your enrolment.

get.summary: Lists all events. Public. Optional filters: search (name), type, location, from (date).

post.summary: Creates a new event owned by the logged-in Organiser.

get.summary: Lists the logged-in Organiser's own events with enrolment totals (for the dashboard).
Returns one event by id. Public.

put.summary: Updates an event. Only the Organiser who created it may do this.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

delete.summary: Deletes an event (and its categories, enrolments and results). Owner only.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

get.summary: Returns the logged-in user's own profile.

put.summary: Updates the logged-in user's own name, email and phone.

409.description: Email already used by another account.

post.summary: Captures a finish time and position for an enrolment. Event owner only.
post.description: IsPublished (default true) controls whether the Participant can see the result.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

409.description: A result already exists for this enrolment (use PUT to change it).

put.summary: Corrects an existing result (including publishing or hiding it). Event owner only.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

get.summary: Returns the results for an event, best rank first. Public sees published results only; the owning Organiser sees all.
Returns the logged-in Participant's own published results (race history), newest event first.

200.description: List of results, each with the number of finishers in that event.

post.summary: Uploads a banner image for an event (stored in Azure Blob Storage). Event owner only.
post.description: Send as multipart/form-data with a file field named "file". JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF, max 5 MB.

200.description: Banner saved; the image URL is returned.

400.description: Missing, too large, or not an image.

403.description: Not an Organiser, or not the owner of this event.

post.summary: Uploads the logged-in Participant's profile picture (stored in Azure Blob Storage).
post.description: Send as multipart/form-data with a file field named "file". JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF, max 5 MB.

200.description: Picture saved; the image URL is returned.

400.description: Missing, too large, or not an image.
